label: apple_noc_live
description: Apple NOC captured during a live pair attempt — the same bytes TestDumpAppleNOC decodes. Known-good: a full Matter operational certificate with a populated DN, extensions and a 64-byte signature.

label: apple_noc_tbs_parity
description: Second Apple NOC — the fixture TestTBSToDER_AppleNOC verifies against its issuing root. Known-good, and it drives the DN-order path that the DER reconstruction depends on.

label: apple_noc_truncated_in_issuer_dn
description: Malformed: the live Apple NOC cut off inside the Issuer DN list. Exercises the truncation path with a prefix the decoder accepts up to the cut.

label: apple_noc_final_end_container_corrupted
description: Malformed: the live Apple NOC with its closing End-of-Container byte replaced by 0xFF, so the outermost container never closes and the tag-control field is out of range.

label: top_level_not_a_structure
description: Malformed: an anonymous 1-byte unsigned int at top level, which Decode must reject before it reads any field.

label: structure_opened_never_closed
description: Malformed: a bare anonymous Structure control byte with no children and no End-of-Container.
